assignment_policy.summary: Deterministic item-aware visual assignment with source-family matching, contextual/aesthetic scoring, and stronger reuse balancing.
notes: Assignments are keyed by canonical Catalogger item ID and join to the item table at runtime.
Specific item words such as implant, armorjack, mirrorshades, magazine, scanner, groundcar, and vehicle upgrade are mapped before the General fallback.
Exact approved-image source-family compatibility is preferred; semantic fallback is used only when a family has no approved candidate.
Global and within-family reuse penalties keep visually similar catalogue runs from collapsing onto a single photograph.
